title: Chromosomal DNA Extraction from Gram-positive Bacteria
author: Anders Kiledal

steps.title: Grow culture and harvest cells
steps.instruction: Inoculate 10 mL rich medium with a fresh overnight culture, incubate on a shaker at the appropriate temperature until the OD600 reaches ~0.8–1.0, then harvest cells by centrifugation for 10 min at 5000 rpm.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in TEN buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 2 mL TEN buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8.0, 10 mM EDTA, 150 mM NaCl).

steps.title: Lysozyme digestion
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL lysozyme (20 mg/mL) and incubate for 20 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL RNase (10 mg/mL) and incubate for 3 min at 65 °C.

steps.title: Surfactant removal (if needed)
steps.instruction: If the strain produces a surfactant that interferes with phase separation, perform the following:

substeps.instruction: Add 0.1 volume 3 M sodium acetate and 1 volume cold isopropanol; mix.
Centrifuge 10 min at 5000 rpm and decant the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 400 µL TEN and 550 µL TEN*; transfer to a microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: SDS and proteinase K lysis
steps.instruction: Add 40 µL SDS, a small scoop of proteinase K, and 550 µL TEN*; vortex and incubate at 60 °C for 2 h.

substeps.instruction: Add 900 µL phenol and mix by inversion.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a clean microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Re‑extraction with phenol and chloroform
steps.instruction: Perform one additional phenol extraction followed by two chloroform:isoamyl alcohol extractions:

substeps.instruction: Add 1 volume phenol, mix, centrifuge, and transfer the upper phase.
Add 1 volume chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1 v/v), mix, centrifuge, and transfer the upper phase.
Repeat the chloroform:isoamyl alcohol extraction a second time.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA by coiling
steps.instruction: Collect the DNA by coiling it onto the end of a glass Pasteur pipet.

steps.title: Air‑dry and resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the coiled DNA, then resuspend it in 100 µL sterile water and let it sit overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation of DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase containing DNA to 10 mL cold 100 % ethanol.
